source_text: Libraries were prepared using the Illumina Nextera XT kit and sequenced in a paired-end 2x300 bp configuration on an Illumina MiSeq using a MiSeq Reagent Kit v3. Library concentration was measured with a Qubit fluorometer and normalized to 4 nM. PhiX was spiked in at 10% to increase base diversity. Sequencing was performed at the Genomics Core Facility, University of Example.
